finding.rationale: The filing explains that the company generates revenue through advertising, consumption-based fees and subscriptions for cloud services, consumer subscriptions (e.g., YouTube, Google One), and app sales. It identifies its customers as advertisers, individual consumers, and enterprise/developer users of its cloud and AI platforms.

citations.quote: •Brand advertising helps enhance users' awareness of and affinity for advertisers' products and services, through videos, text, images, and other interactive ads that run across various devices.

finding.rationale: The filing identifies intellectual property and brands as important assets but does not provide concrete, quantified measures of a durable competitive advantage. Furthermore, the filing explicitly notes that competitors can readily erode the company's position, stating that users can switch to other products with a single click and that competitors may innovate faster or more cost-effectively.

citations.quote: We also seek to maintain certain intellectual property as trade secrets. The confidentiality of such trade secrets and other sensitive information could be compromised, which could cause us to lose the competitive advantage resulting from these trade secrets.

finding.rationale: The filing discusses risks related to acquisitions and operating results in a generic, forward-looking manner, attributing potential issues to external factors or hypothetical scenarios rather than acknowledging specific past failures or setbacks caused by management's own decisions. A 10-K is a limited guide to candour.

citations.quote: Our operating results have fluctuated, and may in the future fluctuate, as a result of a number of factors, many outside of our control, including the cyclical nature and seasonality in our business and geopolitical events. As a result, comparing our operating results (including our expenses as a percentage of our revenues) on a period-to-period basis may not be meaningful, and our past results should not be relied on as an indication of our future performance. Consequently, our operating results in future quarters may fall below expectations.

finding.rationale: The filing states that the primary use of capital is to invest for long-term growth and that management regularly evaluates capital returns to stockholders. It also provides concrete figures for 2025, including $91.4 billion in capital expenditures and $45.4 billion in share repurchases.

citations.quote: The primary use of capital continues to be to invest for the long-term growth of the business. We regularly evaluate our cash and capital structure, including the size, pace, and form of capital return to stockholders.

•Repurchases of Class A and Class C shares were $6.5 billion and $38.9 billion, respectively, totaling $45.4 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025.
•Operating cash flow was $164.7 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025.
•Capital expenditures, which primarily reflected investments in technical infrastructure, were $91.4 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025.
